name: BTN UI Green Marathon 2026
short_description: The BTN UI Green Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event on August 9, 2026, at Universitas Indonesia campus in Depok, Indonesia.
ai_summary: The BTN UI Green Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for August 9, 2026, held on the Universitas Indonesia campus in Depok, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. Organized by IM Road Runner together with Universitas Indonesia and Bank BTN, the event offers four distances: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open, with prices starting from IDR 350,000.

core_facts.organizer: IM Road Runner (with Universitas Indonesia & Bank BTN)

pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km) suit a range of runner abilities
Held on the Universitas Indonesia campus, a distinct and notable venue setting
Backed by a strong organizing partnership including Universitas Indonesia and Bank BTN
Registration is open with an accessible starting price of IDR 350,000
cons: Only the starting price is listed, so full cost details across all distance categories are unclear
No information provided on course route, elevation, or race-day logistics

excerpt_quotes.quote: BTN UI Green Marathon belum bisa nebak gimana rutenya kak soalnya baru pertama tahun ini, UI HM jelas bakal keliling UI buat kategori HMnya
Bukan race biasa, BTN UI Green Marathon 2026 ini beneran nerapin zero plastic dan otomatis nanam pohon buat tiap pelari

research_highlights: This is the inaugural (first-ever) edition of the BTN UI Green Marathon, held at Kampus UI in Depok, Jawa Barat on Sunday, 9 August 2026, so there is no course or organisational track record from prior years
Race categories are 5K, 10K, Half Marathon and Full Marathon, with cut-off times of 1 hour (5K), 2 hours (10K), 4 hours (Half Marathon) and 6.5 hours (Marathon)
The event is organised by Universitas Indonesia together with Bank Tabungan Negara (BTN) as Platinum Sponsor, with IM Road Runner as the race management/event organizer
Marathon finishers only receive the special 42K finisher jersey if they complete the race within the cut-off time

Organizers describe a sustainability angle: participants have said the event applies a zero-plastic approach and plants a tree per runner, with registration proceeds reportedly directed to the UI endowment fund for scholarships
research_watchouts: Because this is a brand-new event in 2026, runners on social media explicitly note they cannot yet predict the exact race route
No independent participant race reports or post-race reviews exist yet, since the event had not taken place at the time of research (race date 9 Aug 2026)
Podium prizes for the 10K/Half Marathon/Marathon are restricted to Indonesian citizens (WNI) for most categories, which foreign participants should note before registering

faqs.question: When is the BTN UI Green Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The BTN UI Green Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 9, 2026. The event will be held on the Universitas Indonesia campus in Depok, Jawa Barat, Indonesia, offering runners multiple distance categories to choose from on race day.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: The BTN UI Green Marathon 2026 offers four distance categories for participants: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race, allowing runners of different experience levels to take part.

faqs.question: Who organizes the BTN UI Green Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The event is organized by IM Road Runner in partnership with Universitas Indonesia and Bank BTN. This collaboration brings together an event organizer, an academic institution, and a bank sponsor to host the marathon on the Universitas Indonesia campus in Depok.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register, and is registration open?
faqs.answer: Registration for the BTN UI Green Marathon 2026 is currently open. Prices start from IDR 350,000, though this figure represents the starting point and costs may vary depending on the chosen distance category, such as the marathon, half marathon, 10km, or 5km.
